chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman, who said:
When Ismail ibn Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) died, Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) went out and walked in front of the coffin without shoes or a cloak.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (AS), title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS)
key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Ismail ibn Abi Abdillah (AS), son of the sixth Imam
key_terms.السَّرِير: The coffin or bier used for carrying the deceased

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Sadiq (AS) conduct himself during his son's funeral procession?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the profound humility of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) during the funeral of his cousin, Ismail ibn Abi Abdillah (AS), by depicting him leading the procession barefoot and without a cloak. This act serves as a practical model of *tawadu'* (modesty) and reinforces the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt's close familial bonds and their embodiment of prophetic simplicity in moments of grief.
